## Triage: first grade, `documentation` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:devpath`, into `pm:queue`. Doc only, no refusal

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T09:23Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- This executes the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/objectui#12201 (one square app icon). The `describe` text on `branding.logo` in `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` belongs to the spec lane.
- **Why p3:** it is a description. It does not block the objectui half, which is dispatched.
- **Direction:** the `describe` says "1:1 square app icon, SVG preferred, at least 64 px", and the generated reference follows.
  - ⛔ No refusal of a non-square value. A URL string does not carry its ratio, and a refusal would be a new validation gate, which defaults to no.
- Triage: lands in `packages/spec` (`domain:spec`); rationale: schema description text.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (#23000: `branding.logo`'s describe states the app's one square icon, 1:1, SVG preferred, at least 64 px; doc only, per triage `6121428844`) · 2026-10-12T18:55Z
Session: `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ`
Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-23000-branding-logo-describe`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23000`
Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `domain:spec#2` (seat post #18549)
File surface (at `origin/main` `62ce45d14` or later; stop on breach and explain in the report): the `logo` member's `.describe()` in `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` (near L955), with its TSDoc if one sits there; the generated artifacts `check:generated` names; one `.changeset/23000-*.md` (`patch`). ⛔ No refusal of a non-square value (triage: a new validation gate, which defaults to no). ⛔ Not objectui or hotcrm.
Container & model: `S` mechanical (one describe sentence), `mode:subagent`, `model: floor tier`. The seat's call, per `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "no path-derived mandate". The compensating control is a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue (the path limb hits `packages/spec/src/**`).
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card (the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/objectui#12201, carried verbatim in the body)`
Thread-read: 6121428844
Serial constraints cleared (all open PRs' file lists read at 2026-10-12T18:54Z): no open PR touches `app.zod.ts`, `liveness/app.json` or `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx`. The `ui` generated shards (`json-schema.manifest/ui.json`) are shared with PR #23080 and the #23004 fold, so landing joins the seat's serial relay (seat post #18549).

This act moves the card `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigns `zhuangjianguo`.
